newsitem.title: USA: U.N. Sec General recommends Iraq oil deal renewal.
newsitem.headline: U.N. Sec General recommends Iraq oil deal renewal.

text.p: The United Nations Secretary General, Kofi Annan recommends renewal of the "oil-for-food" deal on the same terms in a report distributed to members of the Security Council on Monday, a U.N. source said on Monday.
His decision was widely expected and the Security Council must next review his report and agree another resolution to extend the deal.
"He has recommended renewal at present levels and now it is up to the Security Council to act," said the high U.N. official who had seen the report.

The so-called oil-for-food deal was agreed in May, 1996 and implemented in December. The accord allows Iraq to sell up to $2.07 billion of oil and use most of the proceeds to pay for food, medicines and other humanitarian goods.
